capabilities: Compare the active note with clipboard text
Open the comparison in Diff Anything
Validate text size and clipboard contents
extras: Mac-only and desktop-only; on other systems the command reports it cannot run and does nothing. Diff Anything's free version limits files to 5 MB and 10 comparisons per day (each comparison the plugin opens counts toward that limit); a one-time in-app Pro purchase removes these. The plugin itself is free with no settings, reads the note and clipboard only when run, never writes to the vault, and sends nothing over the network.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to compare a note against text from outside the vault side by side.

relations.evidence: Both texts go straight to Diff Anything on your Mac through its diffanything://compare-text link.

summary: Obsidian plugin that opens the active note and clipboard text side by side in the Diff Anything comparison app on Mac.
